answer: Attackers must expend real compute and stake per fake identity, so the cost of reaching a controlling zenith of the graph scales linearly with forged nodes, making large-scale sybil capture economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each agent must solve a unique computational puzzle whose solution is a marble in a shared commitment tree, binding identity to a verifiable vertex in the registration graph. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
